title: Ladder and Lamp
summary: The crater's nightly chore: the lamp-lighters' wagon takes the ring at walking pace, one ladder, one long taper, forty lamps that remember being towers. Tonight the regular shadow-rider is sick, and the Choir will not send fire around the rim unaccompanied — bad manners, bad omens, worse insurance. Ride the circle. Be where the ladder isn't.

objectives.label: Report to the temple steps at dusk
Shadow the lamp-lighters' wagon around the ring — close, slow, unhurried
Return the ladder and the last taper to the temple steps

offer.text: We hear you, courier, and tonight we ask a slow thing. Nessa, our shadow-rider, has a cough the crater has chosen to keep. The lamps still want lighting — forty of them, at walking pace, as it has been done since walking was invented locally.

The wagon goes out at dusk. You will ride behind and apart — close enough to catch the ladder if it falls, never close enough to hear the lighters hum. They hum badly on purpose. It keeps tourists humble.
It's the boringest job in the hollow. That's why it matters. Boring is load-bearing.

accept.text: Rules. Don't boost — the lamps think it's showing off. Don't sing — the lamps have opinions. If lamp eleven lights before the ladder gets there, that's normal now. Act bored. It hates being noticed.

The wagon knows the way; the wagon is older than the way. Simply hold the circle with it, courier, and let the dark arrive in the correct order. We pay in lamp-oil futures, which are exactly what they sound like, and redeemable.
Slowest speed, highest stakes, pay denominated in fire futures. The Choir truly understands the courier economy.

complete.text: Lamp eleven lit early again. Lamp twenty-three flickered when you went past, which is new, and everyone saw me not mention it, which is gossip. You did fine. For a fast person.

Forty lamps, one circle, no interruptions — the dark arrived in the correct order and the ring remembers your engine by name. A true name, we suspect. The ring is selective. Take the oil futures; they mature in winter and appreciate in value and meaning.
Pem on band nine, station. The wavelength of your escort is in tonight's notebooks under 'accompaniment, satisfactory'. Forty years of listening, and the quiet tonight had company. The quiet noticed.
